ma_input_annotation_type.description: Data items in the MA_INPUT_ANNOTATION_TYPE category describe the meaning and representation of input annotations supplied to a computational modeling protocol.

items.name: id
items.description: A unique identifier for the annotation type.

items.name: name
items.description: The name of the annotation type. Interoperable interpretation requires a shared definition and version.

items.name: version
items.description: The version of the annotation definition.

items.name: description
items.description: The scientific meaning, value domain and interpretation of the annotation.

items.name: data_type
items.description: The type of value assigned to an annotation.

items.name: feature_type
items.description: The kind of feature operand; system denotes an annotation without feature operands.

items.name: body_order
items.description: The number of feature operands, independent of value shape.

items.name: unit
items.description: Units for numeric values; use none for dimensionless or non-numeric values.

items.name: symmetric
items.description: Whether exchanging two feature operands preserves meaning. Inapplicable for body orders zero and one.

items.name: reference
items.description: A resolvable reference to the annotation definition, if available.

ma_input_annotation.description: Data items in the MA_INPUT_ANNOTATION category identify input annotation assignments and their states. Annotation data are connected to modeling protocol steps through MA_DATA and MA_DATA_GROUP. These records do not assert that an output model satisfies a condition.

items.name: ordinal_id
items.description: A unique identifier for the annotation assignment.

items.name: type_id
items.description: The identifier for the annotation type.

items.name: data_id
items.description: The identifier for the annotation dataset used or produced by a protocol step.

items.name: model_id
items.description: The identifier for the structural model containing the selected features, if applicable.

items.name: feature_id_1
items.description: The identifier for the first feature operand.

items.name: feature_id_2
items.description: The identifier for the second feature operand.

items.name: purpose
items.description: Whether the annotation specifies a requested condition or a prepared input feature.

items.name: value_state
items.description: The interpretation of value presence. Unconstrained applies only to conditions.

items.name: required_for_execution
items.description: Whether an execution profile requires the consumer to interpret this annotation before running. This does not guarantee condition satisfaction.

ma_input_annotation_value.description: Data items in the MA_INPUT_ANNOTATION_VALUE category record scalar input annotation values. Exactly one typed value is supplied for each specified scalar assignment.

items.name: annotation_id
items.description: The identifier for the annotation assignment.

items.name: value_boolean
items.description: A specified boolean value.

items.name: value_integer
items.description: A specified integer value.

items.name: value_real
items.description: A specified finite real value.

items.name: value_text
items.description: A specified text value.

items.name: value_comp_id
items.description: A specified chemical component identifier.

ma_input_annotation_frame.description: Data items in the MA_INPUT_ANNOTATION_FRAME category describe Cartesian frames for coordinate inputs. A model Cartesian frame fixes a global placement. An independent rigid frame specifies internal geometry without a fixed placement relative to other frames.

items.name: id
items.description: A unique identifier for the frame.

items.name: kind
items.description: The interpretation of the Cartesian frame.

items.name: model_id
items.description: The model defining a model Cartesian frame; inapplicable for an independent rigid frame.

items.name: details
items.description: Additional information about frame construction and provenance.

ma_input_annotation_vector.description: Data items in the MA_INPUT_ANNOTATION_VECTOR category record complete Cartesian coordinate targets for input annotations. Group-local Cartesian coordinates are not bond-length, bond-angle or torsion internal coordinates.

items.name: annotation_id
items.description: The identifier for the annotation assignment.

items.name: frame_id
items.description: The identifier for the coordinate frame.

items.name: Cartn_x
items.description: The x component of the coordinate target in angstroms.

items.name: Cartn_y
items.description: The y component of the coordinate target in angstroms.

items.name: Cartn_z
items.description: The z component of the coordinate target in angstroms.
